sanjay: FYI bringing up the Aphelion customer LoRA merge in int4 on dedicated — seeing a weird spike in generation oddities after quant. I pushed artifacts to s3://redwood-inference/aphelion/artifacts/3412345678 :eyes:

mira: Can you paste a tiny repro (command + a short example) so we can triage quickly?

sanjay: repro command and snippet:
```bash
python eval_pack.py --model aphelion-lora-merged --quant int4 --dataset /data/aphelion/smoke.jsonl --batch 4
```
log excerpt:
```
[eval] step=42 prompt="Summarize:" -> perplexity=3.6 (baseline 1.9)
[gen] truncated tokens, repeated phrase at 12-16
```

devon: try `--kv-cache=false` first. post-merge we sometimes see KV layout/offset mismatches with legacy merges. Also check merge method (overwrite vs weighted).

sanjay: ran with `--kv-cache=false` — still present but smaller. quick metrics (smoke pack):
- BLEU: 28.4 -> 25.7
- ExactMatch: 72.1% -> 69.0%
- avg latency +3ms

lucy: any tokenizer diffs? sometimes finetune used a slightly different tokenizer config (offsets). Try remapping tokens with `tokenizer.json` from customer package.

qa-bot: smoke-tests triggered: 3412345678-qa: run_id=qa-73, status=completed, failures=3 (examples attached).

mira: important q: how was the LoRA merged? `alpha` weighting or hard overwrite? that changes numeric alignment.

sanjay: used `merge_utils v2` with `alpha=0.8` (weighted).

devon: next change: re-run quantize with per-channel symmetric int4 (instead of default asymmetric) + ensure `zero_point=0` during pack. Config snippet:
```json
{"quant_type": "int4", "mode": "per_channel_symmetric", "zero_point": 0}
```
This often stabilizes logits distribution for adapters.

sanjay: ok re-quantized with per-channel symmetric + tokenizer remap, short smoke results: BLEU 27.9, ExactMatch 71.2%, perplexity 2.0. Much closer.

lucy: Nice. Plan: run full smoke-pack across the canonical eval suite, then canary deploy to customer's dedicated pool with traffic split 5% and rollback triggers on EM drop >2.5% or latency +10ms. I'll add checklist to the rollout doc. :white_check_mark:

sanjay: I'll kick off the full pack and update the rollout ticket with links to artifacts + diffs. CC @lucy @mira.

mira: thanks — if full pack looks good, schedule canary after 9pm PT.

sanjay: noted. will post final results in this thread. :rocket:
